name: scan-planner-reproduction
title: Integrate SCAN-Planner Foxy with Lite3 Physics Simulation
description: Port the pinned SCAN ROS 2 planner core to Foxy and validate a versioned TCP closed loop against a pinned Lite3 Isaac policy simulation on the 5070 Ti.
creator: sun
notes: V3 uses the pinned sensor-rig URDF with V12 model_149999 plus live MID-360-like and D435i-like simulated sensors. V4--V6 remain immutable human-change-requested evidence. Trellis review superseded V7 candidate01 despite 119/119 because collision-replan deferral reused the broader execution-frozen signal. R2 uses a catch-up-only topic and a bounded 0.20 m/s catch-up floor; dry runs 16 and 17 passed 120/120. Candidate02 also passed but was superseded after adding compatibility-only empty defaults for V7 variables in the shared runner. Post-fix review candidate03 passed 120/120. Full R2 evidence is local with hash parity. AC35--AC38 pass; AC39 remains entirely Dr Sun's human video decision. No training or real-robot work was performed.
